id.title: Scenario identifier
id.description: Stable machine-readable identity for this derived scenario.
id.x-evidence: Research metadata governed by the versioned scenario contract.
id.x-limitation: Changing the identifier does not change model behavior.

version.title: Scenario version
version.description: Semantic version of this scenario definition.
version.x-limitation: The author is responsible for incrementing this version when meaning changes.

title.title: Scenario title
title.description: Human-readable name shown in reports and discovery views.
title.x-evidence: Descriptive research metadata supplied by the scenario author.
title.x-limitation: A title is not evidence of scientific or clinical validity.

acceptance_level.title: Acceptance level
acceptance_level.description: Level A preserves the historical dissertation timing baseline.
acceptance_level.x-evidence: ADR-0004 and the accepted M7 vertical-slice contract.
acceptance_level.x-limitation: Level A is a software acceptance level, not a clinical evidence grade.

id.title: Run-plan identifier
id.description: Stable label for the intended execution configuration.
id.x-evidence: Research metadata retained in scenario and run provenance.
id.x-limitation: Changing the label alone does not alter the simulation.

master_seed.title: Master random seed
master_seed.description: Non-negative seed from which deterministic stochastic streams are derived.
master_seed.x-limitation: One seed is one stochastic realization; it does not quantify uncertainty.

collector_count.title: Collector population
collector_count.description: Number of collector nanodevices used by the historical timer cohort.
collector_count.x-evidence: The dissertation baseline publishes independent cohorts of 1,000 and 10,000 collectors.
collector_count.x-limitation: Values other than 1,000 or 10,000 are not supported by a predictive interpolation law.

fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint identifier
fingerprint_id.description: Identifier of the target proteome fingerprint in the composed demonstrator.
fingerprint_id.x-evidence: FP9 is the dissertation reference fingerprint used by the accepted M7 workflow.
fingerprint_id.x-limitation: The current cellular profiles are synthetic surrogates, not an FP9-specific proteomic mechanism.

tissue.title: Target tissue
tissue.description: Human-readable tissue associated with the target region.
tissue.x-evidence: The current vertical slice composes the qualified pulmonary model.
tissue.x-limitation: The workbench does not automatically substitute an organ model when this label changes.

region_id.title: Target region identifier
region_id.description: Region identity expected by the composed body and organ artifacts.
region_id.x-evidence: Cross-artifact identity used by the accepted FP9/lung composition.
region_id.x-limitation: The identifier must remain consistent with the referenced model artifacts.
